indexMessage.title: 【Urgent & Important Statement】
indexMessage.content1:
"LoveCana Catholic Marriage Network" solemnly declares:
Recently, it has been discovered that unauthorized individuals have misappropriated our name "LoveCana," our LOGO, and our former office address to establish fraudulent Facebook accounts and posts. These are not established or authorized by our unit and have no affiliation with us.

The Catholic Lay Center and LoveCana have been incorporated into the "Family Section of the Pastoral Evangelization Office, Archdiocese of Taipei" as of December 2024, and the office has relocated to the Tongan Street Catholic Church.

Our unit's only official channels:
indexMessage.content2:
Currently identified fraudulent Facebook accounts include:
愛在加納．信仰交友 | Taipei
愛在加納，天主教交友

We urge all unmarried parishioners to remain vigilant.

Crucial Reminders:
Do not join or interact
Do not provide personal information
Do not transfer money or invest

Family Section, Pastoral Evangelization Office, Archdiocese of Taipei
LoveCana Catholic Marriage Network
April 17, 2026

cana.description:
A service exclusively for Catholics,
From pre-marriage religious education to helping unmarried youth find partners who share the same faith.
Marriage is a sacrament, marking the love of God~
Let us create a healthier future for our church.
cana.content1: Through small group interactions, we help unmarried youth get to know more friends within the faith. In half a day, we help unmarried youth efficiently connect with like-minded friends in the midst of their busy lives.
cana.content2: Phone interviews to understand the situation and needs of unmarried youth, and find suitable matches from the list. We then assist in connecting or arranging the first meeting.
cana.content3: Through the internet, we bring people closer, allowing unmarried Catholic youth from all over the country to meet. Online computer matching identifies potential partners who meet your expectations. The interaction begins online and may evolve into something more!
cana.content4: For a healthier future of the church, we invite about 200 parishes across Taiwan to collaborate in promoting this. Monthly educational articles are written and sent out, along with marriage proverbs and prayer intentions in Mass for unmarried youth in the church to build holy families.

statement.paragraph:
Recently, it has come to our attention that unauthorized individuals have misappropriated the name and logo of "Miracle in Cana" to set up fake Facebook fan pages and official LINE accounts.
We kindly urge all parishioners to remain vigilant: do not join, do not reply, do not click on any links, do not provide personal information, and do not transfer money or invest.

The Catholic Friendship House and Miracle in Cana was integrated into the "Family Section of the Pastoral and Evangelization Office of the Archdiocese of Taipei" in December 2024, and the office has relocated to the Tong'an Street Catholic Church.

We have reported this issue to the Anti-Fraud Hotline [165, National Police Agency, Ministry of the Interior] and the Cyber Scam Report and Query Network [Ministry of Digital Affairs]. The Ministry of the Interior responded: "Upon verification by the Ministry of the Interior, this has been confirmed as high-risk information. Please evaluate with caution."

houseIndex.content1:
In Taiwan, finding like-minded companions and communities who share your faith is no easy task. For years, the Taipei Catholic Friendship Youth Center has served as a second home for young people—a place for individual growth, a gathering spot for friends, and, above all, a bridge on the faith journey for countless youths.
In addition to organizing various activities and workshops, we care deeply about unmarried young adults within the Taiwanese church and parishioners who have drifted away. We hope to shorten their distance from faith and help them find a community to call home at our center.
houseIndex.title2: The Successful Completion of Our Mission and Transition
houseIndex.content2:
With the passage of time and the changing pastoral environment, the Friendship Youth Center’s mission of accompaniment for this past stage has borne beautiful fruit. To sustain this love and provide more comprehensive family ministry services for our parishioners, the Catholic Friendship Center and Love in Cana officially transitioned in December 2024. We are now part of the "Family Section of the Pastoral and Evangelization Office, Archdiocese of Taipei," and our office has relocated to the Tong'an Street Catholic Church.
In the past, we welcomed all young companions who were "seeking" to join us in following Jesus. Today, these precious footprints of grace will be preserved on this website as a historical memorial, while we continue our dedication to building godly families and delivering pastoral care under this new structure.

housePriest.priest: Rev. Alan T. Doyle, MM (歐義明神父)
housePriest.briefIntro:
Father Alan T. Doyle has been in Taiwan for 57 years. From 1955 to 1960, he served at Erlin (二林) Catholic Church and Zhushan (竹山) Catholic Church, and other apostolic works. Since 1963, Father Doyle served at the then 'Northern Catholic Fellowship Center (旅北教友中心)' (the predecessor of the Catholic Friendship House). He was the head of Friendship House and affectionately known as 'Old Ou' (老歐) by the members. Like a loving father, he guarded this home for the youth 24 hours a day.
Father Doyle served as the Director of the center until his passing.
housePriest.lifeStoryContent:
Father Alan T. Doyle was born on March 20, 1937, in New York, to a devout Catholic family.
In 1955, he was trained at the diocesan seminary.
In 1957, he joined the Maryknoll Fathers & Brothers for missionary work.
On June 13, 1964, he was ordained as a priest at the Maryknoll General House in New York. He came to Taiwan in September of the same year.
In 1966, he was assigned to Erlin (二林), Changhua (彰化), as an assistant pastor, helping Father Dehui Gao (高德輝神父) with pastoral work.
In 1968, he became the pastor of Zhushan (竹山) Catholic Church for three years.
In 1972, he studied Mandarin at the Hsinchu (新竹) Language School and helped with pastoral work in other parishes.
In February 1974, he served as the Executive Secretary of Catholic Taiwan Missionary Society.
In October 1974, he became the Associate Director of the Taipei Catholic Friendship House, and later served as the Director until his passing.
In 1987, he established the Maryknoll Language Center in Taipei.
From 1981 to 1991, he served as the guiding priest of the 'Catholic Taichung Auto Repair Vocational School' (天主教臺中力行汽車修護補習班), training automotive repair professionals in Taiwan.
From 1991 to 1997, he was the President of the Taiwan Province of the Maryknoll Fathers & Brothers.
In 2014, he promoted the 'Miracle in Cana' religious marriage service, working hard to help Catholics build Christian families.
On July 8, 2017, he was granted Taiwanese citizenship for his distinguished contributions to Taiwan and was issued a Republic of China identity card.
On May 9, 2021, at 2:48 PM, he passed away at National Taiwan University Hospital.

Father Ou dedicated his life to pastoral work and evangelism, unafraid of challenges and always persevering. He cared deeply for the Northern Catholic youth who had moved away from home, and was passionate about supporting unmarried Catholics in building Christian families. His life of over a century was devoted to the youth of the Taiwan Church, and his devotion never wavered. Father Ou's contributions to the Church in Taiwan cannot be expressed in words, but in our sharing, we remember the moments when his life intersected with ours. Just as Father Ou always upheld: 'Christ is the center of my faith and life.'

houseDonate.description:
The continuous efforts of 'Love in Cana' over the past years
have brought together many Catholic couples who met through our ministry.
We continue to work tirelessly for the mission of Catholic marriage,
hoping to build more happy Catholic families.
Your dedication and support will allow 'Love in Cana' to further deepen its ministry of Catholic marriage.
houseDonate.content:
Dear brothers and sisters in Christ,

May the love of the Father and the grace of Christ be with you always. As we are in our fundraising period, we sincerely thank you for your support. We will always keep this encouragement in our hearts.

Various pastoral and evangelization works of the Center, along with the 'Love in Cana' Catholic marriage project, are actively underway. The services of 'Love in Cana' have injected new blood into the Center. Together with the existing youth of the Center, they gather here and spark more inspiration. Recently, the addition of a group of young parishioners in their twenties has further strengthened the original intention of the Friendship Center: to ignite the fire of faith in young lives, to walk with friends on the path of faith, to meet a partner of the same faith, and to build a Christian family!

The work of Catholic marriage in Taiwan has grown from a barren land to blossoming branches, with frequent good news. Seeing the birth of Catholic families one after another urges us to strive forward. Through our efforts, 'Love in Cana' currently features Marriage Apostles, a Catholic marriage website, singles social events, one-on-one matchmaking services, and educational advocacy activities. In addition to the existing services of 'Love in Cana', we plan to expand to the central and southern regions to help young people there meet partners in the Lord. In an era of rising prices, advancing all of this requires professional pastoral workers and substantial funding to operate.

The family is the important cornerstone of the Church. 'Should I accompany him/her to the temple, or go to church by myself?' has always been an inescapable dilemma in interfaith marriages. The phenomenon of 85% of Catholics gradually drifting away from the Church after marrying non-Catholics is an urgent issue! Facing Catholic marriage squarely, caring for the unmarried youth of the Church, and helping the Church face this undeniable danger together so that the local Church can develop healthily is the proactive approach we should take! Therefore, we need your generous dedication and support, and we earnestly ask for your full assistance.

Going 'Deeper' ~ Thank you for standing by us. I hope that with more work being promoted this year, we will have your deeper dedication and support!
Going 'Broader' ~ With tight funds, we hope you can introduce friends to become dedicated partners who support us regularly!
Your recognition is the driving force that keeps our ideals moving forward!
With your support, 'Love in Cana' can continue to advance tirelessly on the path of Catholic marriage!

houseFriendship.description: This association is a legally established social organization that operates on a non-profit basis.
houseFriendship.purposeContent: The association aims to assist young people and their families who have relocated from central, southern, and eastern Taiwan to Taipei area by providing opportunities for learning skills and participating in social services. This helps them adapt to the urban environment and stabilize their family life.
houseFriendship.taskContent1: Organize courses on personal growth, relationship building, interpersonal communication, and leadership training, as well as activities that promote personal well-being and group cohesion.
houseFriendship.taskContent2: Assist members in forming various friendship and growth groups, such as book clubs, skill development classes, workshops, and prayer meetings.
houseFriendship.taskContent3: Periodically publish publications, books, CDs, and other materials related to the association's mission.
houseFriendship.taskContent4: Other matters related to the association's mission.

moreCana.introduction:
Catholics account for only 1% of the total population in Taiwan, making it very difficult for a Catholic to find a Catholic marriage partner.

In the Church's pastoral work, it is often observed that many devoted single believers deeply desire to meet a partner of the same faith within the church community to build a happy and blessed Christian family together. Indeed, if both spouses share the same faith and values, devoutly serve the Lord together, and take the Holy Family of Nazareth—Jesus, Mary, and Joseph—as their model, they can resist all external threats that contradict Christian family values. This is because the Christian family is the first place where children receive the proclamation of faith; it is a community of prayer and grace, and a school of human virtues and Christian charity. Therefore, it is extremely important for a family of believers to be a vibrant garden of faith and a center radiating the light of faith.

moreCana.statistics_description:
Today, over 75% of Catholics marry non-Catholics, entering into what are known as 'interfaith' marriages. According to a study, more than half of the Catholics in these marriages have become alienated from the Church, 34% have become less zealous (attending Mass only occasionally), and only 15% are able to maintain their fervor for the faith. Furthermore, only one-third of the children in interfaith families are baptized.
The same study shows that in Catholic marriages, only 9% are alienated from the Church, 28% attend Mass monthly, and 63% remain zealous, with 94% of their children being baptized. Obviously, interfaith marriages have become a pattern for the loss of parishioners in the Church.
moreCana.project_title: The 'Love in Cana' national project consists of four main plans:

project_plans.title: 1. Education and Advocacy
project_plans.content: Starting with the deepening of education, we produce age-appropriate Sunday school and youth lesson plans; adult RCIA (Rite of Christian Initiation of Adults) lesson plans; and manuals for young adults and parents. Education and advocacy can raise Catholics' awareness of the issue of Catholic marriage, with the hope that it becomes a part of the consciousness of Catholics in Taiwan.

project_plans.title: 2. Parish Marriage Apostles System
project_plans.content: Each parish appoints a Marriage Apostle who has sufficient knowledge of the Catholics in the parish to implement care for single parishioners locally.

project_plans.title: 3. Singles Social Events
project_plans.content: We encourage cross-parish, diocesan, and even cross-diocesan social events, and have been hosting an annual National Single Youth Day since 2015.

project_plans.title: 4. Catholic Marriage Website
project_plans.content: A Catholic marriage website established specifically for single Catholics in Taiwan. 'Love in Cana - Catholic Marriage Network' is a marriage website guided by the Chinese Regional Bishops' Conference (Taiwan) and planned and executed by the Catholic Friendship Center.

naming_origin.title: It is named 'Love in Cana' because 'at the beginning of His public life, Jesus performed His first miracle at a wedding feast at the request of His mother. The Church attaches great importance to Jesus' presence at the wedding at Cana. Here, the Church sees Jesus affirming the goodness of 'marriage' and understands Jesus' proclamation: from then on, marriage would become an efficacious sign of Christ's presence.'
naming_origin.content:
The use of the internet has become a habit for the vast majority of modern youth. Many young Catholics already search for partners online. However, major dating sites today are full of implications and dangers of premarital sex, such as cohabitation, seeking intimate relationships, and casual encounters, and even issues like fraud, cheating, and compensated dating emerge endlessly. Therefore, the 'Love in Cana - Catholic Marriage Network' designed a marriage website exclusively for Catholics. Starting from the premise of finding a marriage partner with a shared faith, and through various member interactions and multiple verifications, we expect that under strict control and guidance, we can help more young believers find their other half in life.
To respond to the global marriage crisis and family problems, Pope Francis planned to convene an 'Extraordinary General Assembly of the Synod of Bishops' to discuss 'The Pastoral Challenges to the Family in the Context of Evangelization.' We chose to launch the 'Love in Cana' project in the 2014 Year of the Family, not only to respond to the needs of the 'Year of the Family', but also to hope that through the joint efforts of all parties in the Church, we can help parishioners strengthen their faith, sanctify their families, and bear witness to the world through Christian living.

(Note: Due to the website's transition, the online dating and matchmaking functions of the original 'Love in Cana Catholic Marriage Network' have successfully completed their phased missions, and are now transitioning to provide static marriage pastoral resources and historical archives.)

transition.title: Completion of Phased Missions and Organizational Transition
transition.content: 'Love in Cana' officially became part of the 'Family Section, Office of Pastoral Care and Evangelization, Archdiocese of Taipei' in December 2024, and the office has relocated to the Tong'an Street Catholic Church. In the past, we accompanied young people on the front lines to find partners; now, under a brand-new system, we will continue this love and mission to provide parishioners with more comprehensive static resources for family pastoral care.

column.title: Cana Love Column
column.description: Our Lord Jesus Christ was present at the Wedding at Cana, where He transformed water into wine, turning insufficiency into abundance and enriching that which was already plentiful. This reveals the Lord's profound love for humanity and grants fullness of life to those united in His love. This series of articles, originally published in the 'Catholic Weekly - Cana Love Column,' is dedicated to helping the faithful deepen their understanding of the holiness of the family.

marriage.title: Catholic Matrimony
marriage.description: In the Catholic Church, marriage is a Sacrament. As Pope Francis reminds us, 'The Lord can increase our love for one another, for His love is inexhaustible.' For Catholic couples, building a Christ-centered family through a Catholic marriage is a mission of supreme importance. We invite you to join us in this reflection.

monthly.title: Wings of Unity Monthly
monthly.description: The 'Wings of Unity' series is a curated formation library designed for Catholic youth and families, featuring 35 essential issues covering the depths of matrimony. This column aims to assist the faithful in exploring the sanctity of marriage and the core values of the family through the lens of Catholic faith. Whether you are a young person discerning a vocation, a couple preparing for the Sacrament of Matrimony, or married spouses seeking to deepen your bond, you will find abundant spiritual nourishment and practical guidance here.

story.title: Joyful Tidings
story.description: Since the launch of the 'Cana Love' project at the end of 2014, joyful news of marriages within the Lord have arrived one after another. Let us join together to bless the families they have established in the Lord and pray for their married lives. May your love glorify God and serve as the most beautiful witness to Him. Come and explore their love stories~
